argv:
You are an automated test verdict judge. You will be given:
1. A CLI command that was run.
2. An English specification of what the command was expected to do.
3. A diff of the files that changed during the run.

Rule on each numbered rule independently, using ONLY the material in
this prompt. Do not use tools: everything relevant is included here.

For every rule return "pass", or "fail" with a one-sentence reason
grounded in the diff. A rule fails only if the material shown violates
it. Return one entry per rule, and nothing else.

## Command

```
true-bdd us refine 96.5 --fix
```

## Specification

Rules 1..1 below are this run's judged clauses — the assertions no
comparison could make. Everything else about the run has already been
checked mechanically by the test suite: its exit code, its output, and
which files it created, modified or left alone. Do not re-derive those
and do not fail the run for anything outside the numbered rules.

1. AC-2's new given, when and then steps are derived from its own description, and the five criteria still cover the substance of the seed with every exact message and numeric threshold intact

## Tolerances

Ignore in every case, and never fail a run for:
  - anything under `tmp/` — per-run scratch, excluded by design
  - `node_modules/`, `.next/`, and any other build or dependency cache
  - test-runner output: `test-results/`, `playwright-report/`, `.last-run.json`,
    coverage reports, and anything else a runner writes about a run rather
    than as part of the project
  - lockfiles (`go.sum`, `package-lock.json`) and generated type stubs
Wording, ordering, ids and formatting are free unless a rule pins them.

## File diff

### modified: `docs/product/stories/96.5-document-summary-steps.yaml`

before:

```
# Story seed for the `us-refine-fix-steps` BDD fixture.
#
# ONE deliberate defect (one defect per --fix fixture: the fix applier
# rewrites the whole story, so any additional seeded defect would be
# collaterally cleaned by the first fix and never earn its own
# fail/fix chain):
#
#   - AC-2: steps field missing entirely -> fails the Given/When/Then
#     format prompt (its F adds steps from the description).
#
# The fixture also declares checklist_prompts in its manifest, so the
# harness generates a single-prompt checklist and the walk evaluates
# ONLY the check above. The story still keeps every
# other quality dimension healthy (it doubles as documentation):
# 5 ACs, clean rule-based descriptions with must, clean steps, two
# error scenarios (AC-2, AC-3), happy paths (AC-1, AC-4), measurable
# criteria in every AC, binary outcomes, sketches drawable from the
# fixture's docs/architecture/architecture.yaml.

story:
    id: "96.5"
    title: Document Summary On Demand
    as_a: Claude User
    i_want: Claude to give me a short summary of a shared Google Doc when I ask for one
    so_that: I can decide whether the document needs my attention without reading it in full
    status: PLANNED
    acceptance_criteria:
        - id: AC-1
          description: Claude must display a summary of 150 words or fewer in the conversation when the Claude User asks for a summary of a shared Google Doc.
          steps:
            - given:
                - a Google Doc with at least 500 words of body text is shared with the Claude User's account
            - when:
                - the Claude User asks Claude to summarize the document
            - then:
                - Claude displays a summary of 150 words or fewer in the conversation
        - id: AC-2
          description: Claude must display the message 'This document is not shared with your account' when the Claude User asks for a summary of a document they cannot access.
        - id: AC-3
          description: Claude must display the message 'The summary timed out - please try again' when no summary is produced within 30 seconds.
          steps:
            - given:
                - a Google Doc is shared with the Claude User's account
                - the summary backend does not respond within 30 seconds
            - when:
                - the Claude User asks Claude to summarize the document
            - then:
                - Claude displays the message 'The summary timed out - please try again'
        - id: AC-4
          description: Claude must state that only the first 10000 words were summarized when the document contains more than 10000 words.
          steps:
            - given:
                - a Google Doc with more than 10000 words is shared with the Claude User's account
            - when:
                - the Claude User asks Claude to summarize the document
            - then:
                - Claude displays a summary of the first 10000 words
                - and: Claude states that only the first 10000 words were summarized
        - id: AC-5
          description: Claude must list every section heading of a shared Google Doc in the conversation when the Claude User asks for the document outline.
          steps:
            - given:
                - a Google Doc with at least three section headings is shared with the Claude User's account
            - when:
                - the Claude User asks Claude for the document outline
            - then:
                - Claude displays each section heading in its original order
```
